text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerja (Perbekalan) 2018.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa

pada 1 Januari 2018.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2018

2. Suatu jumlah wang yang tidak melebihi lapan ratus lima puluh dua juta

tiga puluh lima ribu ringgit (RM852,035,000) hendaklah dikeluarkan daripada

Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan Sosial bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran

Rancangan Keselamatan Sosial bagi tahun 2018 sebagaimana yang diperuntukkan

dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Peruntukan

Emolumen RM 259,804,715

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan RM 242,705,785

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain RM 73,785,000

Perbelanjaan lain RM 93,841,500

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan RM 181,898,000

Jumlah RM 852,035,000

Dibuat 24 Julai 2018

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)58/XXII]

 M. KULA SEGARAN

 Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 1969

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 72 of the Employees' Social Security

Act 1969 [Act 4], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Employees' Social Security (Supply)

Regulations 2018.

(2) These Regulations are deemed to have come into operation

on 1 January 2018.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2018

2. A sum not exceeding eight hundred and fifty-two million and thirty-five thousand

ringgit (RM852,035,000) shall be issued out of the Social Security Fund for expenditure

on the administration of the Scheme of Social Security for the year 2018 as provided in

the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Allocation

Emoluments RM 259,804,715

Supplies and services RM 242,705,785

Grants, fixed payments and other payments RM 73,785,000

Other expenditures RM 93,841,500

Landed properties, plants and equipment RM 181,898,000

Total RM 852,035,000

Made 24 July 2018

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)58/XXII]

 M. KULA SEGARAN

 Minister of Human Resources
